meta.title: NFL Insights — Suggestions for site improvement (reviewable before implementation)
meta.note: Every entry is a PROPOSAL for improving the site's decision-making support. None is implemented until reviewed and approved. These are internal project proposals — none is source-verified strategy or official NFL data. Source cells are deliberately blank and flagged per the no-inference policy.
meta.purpose: Someone reviews suggestions and chooses the best path before implementing any changes to the live site.

suggestions.title: Add live injury-report refresh to the injury tracking page
suggestions.description: Automatically pull the current official NFL injury report (nfl.com/injuries) each week and re-render the injuries page so the displayed practice/game status is never stale.
suggestions.rationale: Injury values are dynamic and change weekly. A static 2026-11-12 snapshot misleads if read later.
suggestions.decision_impact: High — stale injury status could drive wrong lineup/availability conclusions.
suggestions.source_status: blank — internal proposal, no official source

suggestions.title: Add official depth-chart / backup-order column to injury page
suggestions.description: If the NFL ever publishes depth-chart ordering (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string) on team roster pages, add a column showing which backup would replace an injured starter on defense and offense.
suggestions.rationale: The user specifically asked to know 2nd/3rd/4th string backups replacing starters. The official NFL roster page does not publish this today.
suggestions.decision_impact: High — directly addresses the requested backup-deficiency signal.
suggestions.source_status: blank — depends on NFL publishing depth charts; not currently available

suggestions.title: Publish a 'decision gate' checklist before any site change
suggestions.description: Before implementing any suggestion, require a written checklist: which question it answers, what information is missing, what could go wrong, and who approves.
suggestions.rationale: The user asked for a section where someone reviews suggestions and chooses the best path before implementing changes.
suggestions.decision_impact: Medium — prevents unvetted changes to a verification-bound site.

suggestions.title: Link sibling-session NFL research sites from shared navigation
suggestions.name: Cross-link sibling session sites
suggestions.description: Add navigation links from this nfl-insights/ site to the sibling dashboards (dashboard/, nfl-lines/, skill-lab/, quant-lab/, origination-lab/, etc.) so reviewers can see the full body of verified line-origination and strategy work.
suggestions.rationale: Multiple parallel sessions built complementary NFL research sites. A single entry point helps a reviewer compare them.
suggestions.decision_impact: Medium — improves discoverability of verified research.

suggestions.title: Add weather input to line-origination pages
suggestions.description: Pull NOAA/NWS point forecasts by stadium lat/lon and surface them as an input to the line-origination model (outdoor wind/temperature effects on totals).
suggestions.rationale: Weather is a measurable, officially-sourced input that can affect totals and player props.
suggestions.decision_impact: Medium — adds a legitimate signal input.

suggestions.title: Flag any page that hard-codes a price or odds
suggestions.description: Add a build-time check that fails if any page hard-codes −110 or other implied odds without disclosure and an exclusion count.
suggestions.rationale: Past sessions imputed −110 prices without disclosure (issue #19). A guard prevents recurrence.
